description.value:
The Oath of Saints is sworn by those who would join the storied order of the Knights of Saints. These holy warriors commit themselves not only to the chivalric code, but also to the legacy of the saints who upheld it before them. A knight who lives the code with unwavering devotion may one day be counted among those saints, their name honored by generations to come. The Knights of Saints embody the highest ideals of valor, faith, and moral excellence. Chivalric Code

Charity. Protect the weak with mercy and compassion. Courage. Face fear with steadfast heart.

Faith. Hold loyalty to the Maker above all.

Honor. Uphold truth and integrity even when unseen.

Hope. Trust in the ultimate triumph of righteousness.

Humility. Master pride through self-restraint.

Prudence. Discern the wise path amid turmoil. Oath Ceremony When a new knight is inaugurated into the order, the presiding knight touches a sword to each shoulder, charges the candidate to uphold the code, and invokes the blessing of the Maker and the saints. Only then does the initiate rise as a Knight of Saints. The Seven-Sided Table The order is forever limited to seven knights, each representing a facet of the chivalric code. Together, they serve the ruler who best embodies these virtues. Their oath binds them to that leader alone; when the ruler dies, the knights judge the successor. If the new sovereign fails to exemplify the code, the Knights of Saints depart in search of a worthier patron. Such times of transition are perilous, for rejected rulers often take offense, and vengeance, upon the knights who refuse them.

source.custom: Legends of the Round Table: Chivalric Handbook
